references.text: The prophecy that nations shall stream to the Lord's mountain to worship, paralleled by the call for peoples to go up the mountain to offer righteous sacrifices.
Kings from Tarshish and distant shores shall bring gifts, alluding to the riches of the sea and trade coming from the sea.
The wealth of the sea shall flow to you, and the treasures of the nations shall come to you - paralleled by drawing on the abundance of the sea.
Zebulun's blessing to dwell at the seashore and become a haven for ships, related to the riches of the sea.
The preceding blessing of Zebulun and Issachar which sets the context for verse 19 regarding their shared blessing.
Treasures hidden in the sand and riches from the earth, paralleled by the hidden treasures in the sand.
The land of Zebulun and Naphtali by the sea where a great light shines forth, fulfilling the blessing over these tribes.
